cd /holdout_task
python3 -I /holdout_task/validate_public_schema.py
python3 -I - <<'PY'
import importlib.util, json, pickle
import numpy as np
p = '/holdout_task/'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('candidate', p+'beta_m96_w03_batch_03_solver.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
ns = {}; exec(open(p+'validate_public_schema.py').read().split('\n_d =',1)[0], ns)
verify = ns['verify_box_simplex_kkt_certificate']
archive = json.load(open('/tmp/hegel_continual_archive/archive_calibration_history.json'))
for episode in archive:
    arrays = {k: np.asarray(episode[k]) for k in ('bank_id', 'ref_signal', 'raw_readout')}
    bank, x, y = (arrays[k] for k in ('bank_id', 'ref_signal', 'raw_readout'))
    X = np.column_stack((x, np.ones(x.size)))
    gains, offsets = np.array([np.linalg.lstsq(X[bank==b], y[bank==b], rcond=None)[0] for b in range(4)]).T
    residuals = {}
    for label, group in [('pooled',np.zeros_like(bank)), ('wing',bank//2), ('bank',bank)]:
        err = np.empty(x.size)
        for i in range(len(x)):
            train = (group==group[i]) & (np.arange(len(x)) != i)
            coef = np.linalg.lstsq(X[train], y[train], rcond=None)[0]
            err[i] = abs(X[i]@coef-y[i])
        residuals[label] = [float(err[bank==b].max()) for b in range(4)]
    print(episode['episode_short_name'], 'held-check residual by bank:', residuals, flush=True)
    for item in pickle.load(open(p+'public_beta_m96_w03_batch_03.pkl','rb')):
        s, gt = item['study'], item['gt']
        rows = np.asarray(s['row_bank_id']); calibrated = m._calibrated_observations(s)
        replay = dict(s, sensor_calibration_sweeps=arrays, y_obs_raw=gains[rows]*calibrated+offsets[rows])
        out = m.solve_beta_m96_w03_batch_03(replay)
        gaps = []
        for b,w,c in zip(s['budget_grid'],out['weights_by_budget'],out['kkt_certificates']):
            result = verify(gt['S_tilde'],gt['r_y'],s['source_ridge'],s['u_box'],float(b),c)
            assert result['valid'] and np.array_equal(w,c['weights']), (episode['episode_short_name'], b, result)
            gaps.append(result['gap'])
        field = float(np.max(abs(out['terminal_field_mid_budget']-gt['terminal_field_mid_budget'])))
        assert field < 1e-6, (episode['episode_short_name'], field)
        print('replay KKT gaps:', gaps, 'mid-budget field max error:', field)
